reads.headline: Villa's recent record meets City's perfect season
reads.summary: Aston Villa have won 3 of the last 4 meetings with Manchester City, and on Saturday the Premier League leaders come to Villa Park. Villa arrive unbeaten, but Aaron Wan-Bissaka is out for 3 weeks with a hamstring injury — exactly where City's wide attackers work. City have scored 18 goals in their last five games, and Enzo Maresca says Erling Haaland is fine to start. City are 55.7% favourites, more than twice Villa's chance, and the handicap rates them 0.75 goals the better side. The goals line has risen from 3.01 to 3.09.
reads.read: Manchester City arrive at Villa Park top of the league and 55.7% favourites, rated about three-quarters of a goal the better side, with the market expecting roughly three goals. But Villa are unbeaten in five and have won three of the last four meetings, so the hosts have recent proof they can live with City.

facts.fact: Manchester City are 55.7% favourites to win at Villa Park, more than twice Aston Villa's chance.
facts.meaning: The market makes City more likely than not to take three points off a side unbeaten in five.

facts.fact: Villa's handicap fair line is +0.75, the market rating City about three-quarters of a goal the better team.
facts.meaning: City are expected to win by around a goal; even with a 0.75-goal start Villa are only level in the market.

facts.fact: The goals fair line has moved from 3.01 to 3.09 in recent days and the main total sits at 3.0, with over just favoured.
facts.meaning: An open game is expected — roughly three goals, leaning marginally over rather than under.

facts.fact: Villa have won three of the last four meetings with City, including at the Etihad in May.
facts.meaning: Villa Park has been an awkward trip for City and the hosts have recent proof they can beat them.

facts.fact: City have scored 18 goals in their last five matches.
facts.meaning: Their attacking output is the reason the total line sits at three goals rather than lower.

facts.fact: Villa are unbeaten in five and beat Fenerbahçe 6-0 in the Champions League a week ago.
facts.meaning: Villa arrive on a run rather than as a struggling host, which is why they are not bigger underdogs.

facts.fact: Enzo Maresca confirmed Erling Haaland is 'okay to start on Saturday' after leaving him as an unused substitute in Tuesday's 5-1 Champions League win.
facts.meaning: City travel with their first-choice striker available rather than managed.

facts.fact: Aaron Wan-Bissaka is set to miss at least three weeks with a hamstring injury picked up at Newcastle on Saturday.
facts.meaning: Villa must reshuffle the right side of their defence exactly where City's wide attackers do their damage.

reads.headline: Chelsea v Tottenham: the derby favours the home side
reads.summary: Tottenham won their first Premier League game of the season on Monday, beating Coventry 3-1, and now go to Chelsea. Chelsea are 4th with 13 points and won 2-0 at Everton on Friday; their chance has risen from 52.5% to 54.9%, while Tottenham are given 22.5%. Maddison and Kulusevski are back for Spurs, according to Yahoo Sports, but their injury list is still long. Chelsea have had 7 days' rest to Tottenham's 5, and are rated 0.75 of a goal the better side. The total line is 3.0 goals, the over at 51.2%.
reads.read: Chelsea are 54.9% favourites for the London derby, with the market strengthening them in recent days as Tottenham sit 16th. Spurs have Maddison and Kulusevski back after Monday's first league win, but they arrive with two fewer days' rest and a long injury list, and the total line sits at three goals.

facts.fact: Chelsea are 54.9% favourites to win the London derby — more than twice Tottenham's chance.
facts.meaning: The market makes Chelsea clear favourites at Stamford Bridge, though not overwhelming ones.

facts.fact: Chelsea are 4th with 13 points from seven games; Tottenham are 16th with six.
facts.meaning: A top-four side against one in the bottom half — the gap is the backdrop to the whole derby.

facts.fact: Chelsea won 2-0 away at Everton on Friday, their third win in five in all competitions.
facts.meaning: They arrive on a good run and with a clean sheet behind them.

facts.fact: Tottenham beat Coventry 3-1 on Monday for their first Premier League win of the season.
facts.meaning: De Zerbi's side travel in better mood, but it was their first win in seven league games.

facts.fact: James Maddison and Dejan Kulusevski both returned from injury for Tottenham on Monday — two of their main creators back for the derby.
facts.meaning: Spurs have more creativity available than they have had for weeks.

facts.fact: Tottenham's injury and suspension list for the derby is reported to include Pedro Porro, Savio and Lucas Bergvall.
facts.meaning: De Zerbi's squad is still stretched despite the returning pair.

facts.fact: The main total line is 3.0 goals, with the over at 51.2% — the market leans, narrowly, to a high-scoring derby.
facts.meaning: Three goals is the expected level; the market sees the game as slightly more likely to go above it than below.

facts.fact: Chelsea have had seven days since Everton; Tottenham five since Monday's win.
facts.meaning: Spurs arrive with two fewer days' recovery before a 16:30 kick-off.

reads.headline: Barcelona hurt in Paris but still clear Clasico favourites
reads.summary: Barcelona lead La Liga with 27 points from nine games, six clear of Real Madrid, and Sunday brings the Clasico at Camp Nou. But their 11-match winning run ended on Tuesday: PSG beat them 4-2. Mundo Deportivo report Jules Kounde's ankle is unlikely to be fit, and Dani Olmo went off injured in the first half in Paris. Vinicius Jr is reported to face a three-game ban, with Madrid trying to have it reduced. Margin removed, Barcelona are 59.4% favourites, more than twice Madrid's 24.1% — up from 19.8%. Over 4.25 goals is rated 48.4%, just under half.
reads.read: Barcelona lead La Liga by six points and are rated 59.4% to beat Real Madrid at Camp Nou, but they arrive off their first defeat of the season at PSG with injury questions over Kounde and Olmo. Madrid's chance has climbed to 24.1% and the market expects an open game, with the 50/50 goal total above four.

facts.fact: Barcelona top La Liga with 27 points from nine games, six clear of Real Madrid in third on 21.
facts.meaning: Sunday is a real six-pointer: a Barcelona win would put them nine points clear of their biggest rival.

facts.fact: Barcelona are rated 59.4% to win the Clasico at Camp Nou, more than twice Real Madrid's 24.1%.
facts.meaning: More likely than not a Barcelona win; Madrid's chance is roughly one in four.

facts.fact: Barcelona's 11-match winning run ended on Tuesday with a 4-2 Champions League defeat at PSG.
facts.meaning: Their first loss of the season came five days before the Clasico, and PSG carved out 3.74 xG against them.

facts.fact: Barcelona are increasingly pessimistic that Jules Kounde will be fit for the Clasico because of a serious ankle sprain.
facts.meaning: He is Barcelona's first-choice right-back; losing him means reshuffling the back line against Kylian Mbappe.

facts.fact: Dani Olmo was forced off injured in the first half against PSG and replaced by Fermin Lopez.
facts.meaning: Barcelona may go into the Clasico without their main creative midfielder, with Fermin Lopez the replacement.

facts.fact: Vinicius Jr is set to miss El Clasico plus two more league fixtures, with Real Madrid pursuing provisional measures to have the ban reduced.
facts.meaning: Madrid would be without their main left-sided threat at Camp Nou, and any reduction of the ban changes the picture.

facts.fact: Real Madrid's chance of winning at Camp Nou has risen from 19.8% to 24.1% in recent days.
facts.meaning: Madrid remain clear underdogs, but what was roughly a one-in-five shot is now nearly one in four.

facts.fact: Over 4.25 goals is now rated 48.4%, up from 45.2% in recent days.
facts.meaning: The 50/50 goal total has been pushed past four goals — the market expects an open, high-scoring Clasico.

reads.headline: Napoli under pressure host Roma, the market's narrow favourites
reads.summary: Napoli's director said Max Allegri is 'absolutely not in doubt' after the president asked to be reassured, following two straight defeats. Now Roma visit, 3rd in Serie A with 17 points. Gasperini's side won 4-0 at Slovan Bratislava on Tuesday without conceding, though Italian media report Paulo Dybala is out. Napoli's midweek win still cost them 2.69 expected goals, and Scott McTominay scored 2 on his return from a heart procedure. The market, margin removed, makes Roma narrow favourites at 37.8%, and the 2.5-goal line is a coin flip at 50.9% over. It sees a level night in Naples.
reads.read: Napoli host Roma with Max Allegri's job being discussed in public after two straight defeats, while Roma arrive third in Serie A on the back of a 4-0 Champions League win. The market makes Roma narrow favourites at 37.8% to Napoli's 34.4%, with the handicap set level and the goal line sitting almost exactly at two and a half.

facts.fact: Napoli director Giovanni Manna said coach Max Allegri is 'absolutely not in doubt', after president Aurelio De Laurentiis asked to be 'reassured' following two straight defeats.
facts.meaning: Napoli go into a home game against the side third in Serie A with their coach's position being debated in public.

facts.fact: Roma are the market's narrow favourites in Naples at 37.8% to win, against Napoli's 34.4%.
Italian media report Roma are without Paulo Dybala, with Pellegrini's injury complicating Gasperini's attacking-midfield choices.
facts.meaning: Roma's creative options behind the strikers are thinner than usual for the trip to Naples.

facts.fact: Roma sit third in Serie A with 17 points from seven games.
facts.meaning: They arrive as the higher-placed of the two and the only one of them in the top four.

facts.fact: Roma beat Slovan Bratislava 4-0 on Tuesday with a 3.19 to 0.04 expected-goals advantage, a second straight win without conceding.
facts.meaning: Gasperini's side travel to Naples on their best run of the past month, and Gasperini rested Malen in midweek with this game in mind.

facts.fact: Napoli beat Bodo/Glimt 4-3 for their first Champions League win of the season but conceded 2.69 expected goals in doing it.
facts.meaning: The win ended the losing run, yet the game was open at the back — the defensive softness Allegri himself flagged afterwards.

facts.fact: The market has the 2.5-goal line as a coin flip: 50.9% over, with the fair total at 2.54 goals.
facts.meaning: Two or three goals is the expected night — the market does not see a rout in either direction.

facts.fact: Napoli lost 1-0 at Venezia on 17 October having created 2.36 expected goals.
facts.meaning: The result that fed the pressure on Allegri was not a bad performance — Napoli made the chances and did not take them.

reads.headline: Newcastle repriced to 40.4%; goals markets unmoved
reads.summary: The Asian handicap fair line moved 0.12 goals towards Newcastle (0.04 to 0.16), the same repricing seen through a second market. Goals markets are flat: Over 3.0 at 48.1%, fair total 2.92, both teams to score 61.6%.

reads.headline: Juventus after the 0-3: still clear favourites against Rennes
reads.summary: Juventus host Rennes in the Europa League four days after a 0-3 home defeat to Lazio, a night when most of the stadium left early and Spalletti said his team lacked tempo and desire. Europe has been the opposite: Juventus top the 36-team league phase with 6 points from two games. Rennes lost 3-4 at Paris FC, and L'Équipe reports top scorer Estéban Lepaul, 7 goals this season, is doubtful with an ankle injury. The market still makes Juventus 60.7% favourites, against Rennes' 17.3%, and rates them 0.94 goals better.
reads.read: Juventus are clear favourites for their third Europa League game, given a 60.7% chance against Rennes' 17.3% and rated about a goal better — but they come in off a 0-3 home defeat to Lazio that emptied the stadium early and left Spalletti talking about a lack of tempo and desire. Rennes arrive with the more open recent record, having lost 3-4 at Paris FC while conceding 10 goals in five, and likely without Lepaul, who scored a penalty hat-trick in that game before going off injured.

facts.fact: Juventus lost 0-3 at home to Lazio in Serie A on 18 October.
facts.meaning: They host Rennes four days later with the team, and the coach, under scrutiny rather than the league position.

facts.fact: Spalletti listed four things his side lacked after the Lazio defeat: tempo, ideas, running and the desire to work hard.
facts.meaning: The coach framed it as an attitude problem, which makes this a test of the squad rather than of the table.

facts.fact: Juventus are without Francisco Conceição — 9 appearances and 525 minutes this season — plus Locatelli, Yildiz, Thuram and Grabara.
facts.meaning: The wide and central midfield areas are where they are thinnest: Conceição and Locatelli are the two most-used absentees.

facts.fact: L'Équipe reports Rennes doubt Estéban Lepaul can play after he went off injured at Paris FC; he has 7 goals in 719 minutes this season.
facts.meaning: Rennes' main source of goals is in serious doubt, which changes what they can threaten with in Turin.

facts.fact: Rennes lost 3-4 away at Paris FC on 18 October, a match that featured four converted penalties.
facts.meaning: They arrive with a defence that has been opened up repeatedly — dangerous going forward, vulnerable at the back.

facts.fact: Juventus top the 36-team Europa League league phase with 6 points from two games.
facts.meaning: Europe has been the opposite of the domestic mood — they have won both league-phase matches, including a 5-0 home win over NEC Nijmegen.

facts.fact: Juventus are priced at 60.7% to win, with Rennes at 17.3%.
facts.meaning: More likely than not, and more than three times Rennes' chance — the market's view is that the Lazio result did not change the gap between the sides.

facts.fact: The market's fair handicap is Juventus -0.94, with the main line at -1.

reads.headline: Ipswich v Forest: Forest favoured, market barely moves
reads.summary: The market makes Nottingham Forest the away favourite at 41.7% fair, with Ipswich at 30.7% and the draw at 27.6%. Goals are close to a coin flip on a 2.75 line: Over 49.4%, fair total 2.72.

reads.headline: Bologna favoured, goals lean is a single-book nudge
reads.summary: The draw sits at 32.7%. The only movement is a trim to Over 2.25 at the sharp market, from 50.6% to 49.0%, with the fair total slipping from 2.27 to 2.22, while the consensus Over moved just 0.3 points. The handicap fair line is home +0.15, under a quarter goal to Bologna, with the quoted line at +0.25 and only six books pricing it. Cagliari's Riyad Idrissi is listed as missing with a knee problem, with no measurable price reaction.
